items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: They had a fellow singing with them -- when I joined them, by the name of Sonny Boy Williams.

ctx.x: And I went by the band to hear this band. Now there was also a band -- now I don't know whether this is the same band or not, it was headed -- that Cab was directing at that time. Now I wonder sometimes if that was

the same band, because I also heard Cab around that time and with some band, I don't know I think that was the same band, Hardy's Alabamians. They had a fellow singing with them -- when I joined them, by the name of Sonny Boy Williams. And he was imitating Cab. It could've been Sonny Boy Williams.
The original -- the old blues singer, Sonny --
